What is Duolingo Max?

The top subscription tier of Duolingo, adding GPT-powered features to the gamified language course: Explain My Answer, Roleplay conversations with characters, and Video Call with Lily, a simulated live conversation partner.

Best for

Habit-forming beginner-to-intermediate language practice with conversation rehearsal.

Main features

  • Explain My Answer (AI explains why a response was wrong)
  • Roleplay (open-ended conversation practice with scripted scenarios)
  • Video Call with Lily (simulated video conversation at your level)
  • everything in Super Duolingo (no ads, unlimited hearts, personalised practice)
  • streak and gamification systems
  • Duolingo Score.

Practical use cases

  • Daily language practice
  • conversational rehearsal before travel
  • understanding grammar mistakes without a teacher
  • maintaining a study habit through gamification.

Who is it for?

  • Self-directed language learners at beginner to intermediate level; casual learners; schools via Duolingo for Schools.

Pricing, free access & limits

Consumer subscription tiers

Plans described in the source

Free with ads. Super Duolingo around $12.99/mo or roughly $83.88/yr. Duolingo Max around $29.99-30/mo or roughly $167.99-180/yr (Max includes all Super features). Family plans available for both tiers at a significant per-person discount (typically up to 6 members). Prices vary by country and Duolingo runs frequent promotions.

Free plan

The core Duolingo course has free access; this does not establish a free plan for Duolingo Max. Yes - the core Duolingo course is free, ad-supported, with limited hearts.

Free trial

Yes - free trials of Super and Max are routinely offered (typically 7-14 days).

Usage limits to consider

Video Call and Roleplay have daily or session caps even on Max. Max is not available for every language pair - coverage is strongest for Spanish, French and a handful of others from English.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Best-in-class habit formation and gamification
  • Explain My Answer solves the biggest gap in self-study - not knowing why you were wrong
  • Roleplay gives low-anxiety speaking practice
  • very large free tier.

Limitations to consider

  • Max is expensive relative to the incremental value over Super
  • AI features cover few language pairs
  • ceiling is roughly intermediate - it will not get you to professional fluency
  • the gamification can reward streak-keeping over actual learning
  • no Arabic-from-English Max support at the time of writing.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, iOS, Android

Languages

  • 40+ courses; Max AI features available for a much smaller subset of language pairs

API access

No public API for the learning product

Integrations and exports

  • Duolingo for Schools
  • Apple/Google subscription billing
  • Duolingo English Test is a separate product

Evaluation notes

Check whether Max AI features actually exist for your specific language pair before subscribing - this is the single most common disappointment. Super is often the better value purchase.
